about.version.title: Version
about.helper.hint: A service that makes changes with administrator rights.
about.helper.state_outdated: outdated — updates at the first action
about.core.damaged: files are damaged, possibly by antivirus
about.core.missing: files not found, possibly removed by antivirus
about.lists.title: Lists
about.app.verify_note: The file is verified by its signature. Administrator rights are usually not needed; if the helper is out of date, there is one rights prompt. You can go back to the current version.
about.app.rollback_tip: Run the previous version; it is stored alongside
about.app.hint_only: {version} available. The file is verified by its signature before updating.
about.app.reason_stale: the source's description is out of date
about.app.no_release: The description of version {version} was not received — it cannot be updated from the window. It can be downloaded from the releases page.
about.app.os_too_old: Version {version} needs a newer Windows — it cannot be installed on this PC.
about.app.manual_link: Does not help — download from the releases page ↗
about.app.signature_failed: The release description failed the signature check — no update is offered. You can download it from the releases page.
about.app.stale: Could not check for app updates: the release description is older than {days} days, the source may be spoofed. You can download it from the releases page.
about.app.found_new: Version {version} is out — you can update it in “About & updates”.
about.check.needs_new_app: The new lists need a newer app version — download it from the releases page.
about.check.app_newer: Lists are up to date. Version {version} is out.
about.check.sources_failed: Sources did not respond — will check again at the next start. {errors}
about.check.stale: Could not check for updates: the source's description is out of date. {errors}
about.app.busy_update: Another operation is in progress — wait for it to finish and click “Update” again, otherwise the restart would cut it off.
about.app.busy_retry: Another operation is in progress — wait for it to finish and try again.
about.app.start_failed: Version {version} did not start: {reason} The previous one is running.
about.app.update_failed: Update failed: {error} The app is unchanged.
about.app.no_previous: The previous version was not found — its files were deleted or moved.
about.app.rollback_confirm: Go back to version {version}? The app will restart; settings and lists are kept.
about.app.rollback_start_failed: Version {version} did not start: {reason} The current one is running.
about.app.start_problem_win32: Windows did not start the file — it may be blocked by antivirus.
about.app.start_failed_back: Version {version} did not start — the previous one ({current}) is open. You can retry the update here.
about.status.daily: {lists} · checked once a day at start
about.info.title: Information
about.info.faq_link: FAQ and how to restore everything ↗
about.info.third_party: Third-party licenses are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt next to the app.
